# Grok Bot

> Community guide for xAI / Cursor Grok Bot: how to start, first job, one shared computer, plan conflicts, and Recover before Reset. Not grok.com chat, not Grok Build, not grok-app.

Official product: https://x.ai/bot
Official docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview
This site: https://grokbot.run/

## Start

- [Guide](https://grokbot.run/): how to start, login, plans, fixes
- Header Find on every page: type a page, symptom, or tool name. Results jump to an existing URL. `/?q=` opens the same lookup. There is no separate /search/ page.
- [Handbook](https://grokbot.run/learn/): lessons in order
- [What is Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/what-is-grok-bot/): not grok.com
- [Install and login](https://grokbot.run/learn/install/)
- [Cursor and Grok Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/cursor/): one account, two apps
- [First Bot](https://grokbot.run/learn/first-bot/)
- [After week one](https://grokbot.run/learn/operator/): manage a roster from named field posts
- [X, Cursor, MCP](https://grokbot.run/learn/ops/): official X plugin as research, Cloud Agent for the repo, remote MCP
- [Skills and routines](https://grokbot.run/learn/skills-routines/)
- [Shared computer](https://grokbot.run/learn/computer/)
- [Plugins and MCP](https://grokbot.run/learn/plugins/)
- [Usage and On-Demand](https://grokbot.run/learn/cost-and-pitfalls/)
- [Pricing](https://grokbot.run/pricing/): no invented list prices
- [Glossary](https://grokbot.run/learn/glossary/)

## Facts this site will not invent

- Isolation is per user, not per Bot. All Bots share one computer.
- There is no separate Grok Bot account. Login is Cursor.
- Weekly usage can spill into On-Demand.
- Self-hosted GitHub repos are not unofficial official clients.
